name: Jens Erikgaard
bio:
Jens Erikgaard's career in motorsport security began unexpectedly. Initially a police officer in Copenhagen, his meticulous approach and dedication to protocol caught the attention of a Formula 3 team during a Danish Grand Prix support race. He transitioned into motorsport security, quickly rising through the ranks thanks to his unwavering commitment to safety and his ability to anticipate potential problems. His approach is proactive, focusing on preventative measures and rigorous risk assessments. Jens is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to maintain order in chaotic situations, making him a highly valued asset to any team.

At Sprint Masters, Jens has implemented a comprehensive security protocol that encompasses everything from paddock access to data protection. He’s a firm believer in teamwork and open communication, fostering a collaborative environment among his security personnel. Jens values loyalty above all else and expects the same level of dedication from his team that he provides to Sprint Masters. His years of experience in law enforcement and motorsport security have given him a unique perspective on how to safeguard valuable assets and protect personnel in a high-pressure environment.

physical.description: A stocky man with a stern face, Jens has the build of someone who used to be a police officer.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations.
Has a habit of adjusting his tie, even when he isn't wearing one.
Drinks black coffee religiously, at exactly 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM.
